# RejectWriter

*Block · writers · `linecaster.blocks.writers`*

Writes every page that carries errors to the task's rejects file and passes every page on.

|  |  |
|---|---|
| Unit | page |
| Role | writer |
| Reads | - |
| Adds | - |
| Replaces | - |
| Comes after | - |
| Comes before | - |
| Used in | - |
| Source | [rejects.py](https://github.com/storytracer/linecaster/blob/main/src/linecaster/blocks/writers/rejects.py) |

The contract is that of `RejectWriter(output_folder='out/rejects')`; the comes-after and comes-before rows are derived from every block's contract.

## Options

| Option | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `output_folder` | `DataFolderLike` | required | the folder (local path, fsspec URI or `DataFolder`) the rejects go to. |
| `prefix` | `str` | `''` | put before each file name, so two writers that share a folder stay apart. |

## Behavior

The file is `<output_folder>/<prefix><rank:05d>.jsonl`, opened on the first reject (a task without rejects
leaves no file), one line per error of `doc.metadata["errors"]`: `key` (the page id), `field` (else the
step or block that failed), `error`, `raw_value`, and the entry's other keys (`block`, `step`,
`preset`, `type`). The page records keep the failed pages with their errors. The builder puts one before the
first writer of a pipeline with a run folder (`<run_folder>/rejects`) when it has none.

## Contract

```mermaid
flowchart LR
    B["RejectWriter"]
    r0["page stream"] --> B
    B --> a0["page stream"]
```
